name: Track Raw Statistics
summary: Creates over 100 scoreboard objectives (prefix ts_) that mirror vanilla statistics such as deaths, distance travelled, items crafted, ores mined and mob kills, in raw units. Operators can show them as leaderboards.

mechanics.title: Objectives created
mechanics.description: Deaths, kills, animals bred, distances (walk, sprint, swim, fly, climb, fall, crouch, boat/horse/pig/minecart rides), play time, damage dealt/taken, chests/ender chests/shulker boxes opened, crafts, villager trades, jumps; crafting counts for beacons, end crystals, conduits and shulker boxes; use counts (potions, totems, torches, golden apples, bone meal, buckets, ender pearls and more); tool break counts (diamond/netherite tools, bow, shears); ore mining counts including deepslate variants; per-mob kill counts (about 70 mobs) and per-mob 'killed by' counts. Values are raw: distances in centimetres, play time in ticks.

mechanics.title: Showing a leaderboard
mechanics.description: Nothing is displayed by default. An operator runs, for example, /scoreboard objectives setdisplay sidebar ts_Deaths (or list / below_name).

commands_and_keybinds: /scoreboard objectives setdisplay <sidebar|list|below_name> <objective> : (operators) show a ts_ objective
getting_started: Operators pick an objective, e.g. /scoreboard objectives setdisplay sidebar ts_Deaths.
editor_notes: Admin/server feature with no player-visible output by default. Objective names listed in load.mcfunction; document as 'about 250 objectives' only if you count them.
